text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israeli schoolgirls killed by Jordanian soldier.
- Strauss expected to acquire Federman shares in Elite Industries for $66 million, twice market value.
- Israeli Infrastructure Minister Sharon to go to Russia in coming weeks to begin negotiations on possible Israeli gas purchases from Russia.

- Sharon to present plan to build artificial islands off Israeli coast; will ask for committee to be set up to investigate idea over next six months; each island would measure sq km, house 20,000 people, draw another 20,000 each day to jobs, local airport could be built on one island.
- Jordan's King Hussein asks to come and pay personal condolences.
- Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu, Palestinian President Arafat talk; Israeli President Weizman tries to get them to meet.
- Killing of girls on the Island of Peace.
